# Good Casus Belli Examples
# Demonstrates proper CB structure with outcome effects and valid costs

# Example 1: Full CB with all outcome effects and valid cost
conquest_cb_example = {
	war_score_from_battles_factor = 1.0

	valid_to_start = {
		is_at_war = no
		prestige >= 100
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = { is_alive = yes }
	}

	cost = {
		prestige = 100
	}

	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = 200
		}
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige = -100
		}
	}

	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = -200
			add_gold = -50
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = -50
		}
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}
}

# Example 2: Minimal valid CB
raid_cb_example = {
	valid_to_start = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}
}

# Example 3: CB with complex victory conditions
holy_war_cb_example = {
	war_score_from_battles_factor = 0.75

	valid_to_start = {
		is_at_war = no
		piety >= 200
		NOT = { faith = scope:defender.faith }
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { is_alive = yes }
			faith = scope:defender.faith
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = 200
		gold = 50
	}

	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_piety = 500
			add_prestige = 200
		}
		scope:defender = {
			add_piety = -200
		}
	}

	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_piety = -300
			add_prestige = -100
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_piety = -100
		}
	}
}
